description: Owner, evidence, and missing-contract map for the dag-ml cutover and adjacent V1 ecosystem blockers.

policy.default_engine_flip_condition: Post-W2J integration already has DEFAULT_ENGINE=dag-ml. Keep the release gate strict: all required_for_cutover blockers must be ready or passed, every referenced required gate must pass, coverage_meter.summary.fallback must stay 0, fallback must remain explicit opt-in only, and dag-ml export must not perform an implicit legacy refit.
policy.advisory_scope: Advisory blockers track V1 ecosystem readiness that should not by itself block the nirs4all DEFAULT_ENGINE cutover.

blockers.title: Cutover gate runner and contracts are self-validating
expected_evidence: drop-gates.n4a.json validates
readiness-matrix.n4a.json validates
runner can list gates and readiness from a plain ecosystem checkout
blockers.missing_contract: None for tooling; this row guards future edits to the cutover contracts.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep this gate green whenever cutover docs or runner code changes.

blockers.title: Full Python reference fallback ledger is empty
expected_evidence: coverage_meter --check passes
coverage_meter.summary.fallback == 0
no remaining EXPECTED_FALLBACK entry relies on implicit legacy execution
blockers.missing_contract: None for the fallback ledger at the current post-W2J integration tip: docs/compatibility.json records coverage_meter.fallback == 0 and expected_fallback is empty.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep post_w2j_cutover_state and pyref_coverage_zero green; any new fallback must be recorded as a regression, not a new release default.

blockers.title: Installed n4m proof is release-gated with explicit local dependencies
expected_evidence: scripts/prove_installed_n4m.py runs in _worktrees/RC-v1-nirs4all-python
the proof installs and consumes n4m/libn4m from the proof virtualenv
dag-ml and dag-ml-data are supplied through explicit local sibling paths
blockers.missing_contract: None for the W2S local dependency proof. The gate remains strict: unresolved unpublished dependencies or missing Rust-backed local packages fail instead of falling back to ambient PYTHONPATH.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep installed_n4m_proof in the non-full release gate run; do not replace it with the default ambient proof.

blockers.title: Native .n4a export covers stacking replay without legacy bridge
expected_evidence: native .n4a bundle tests pass without xfailed stacking replay
base producer order and meta-feature construction are persisted
bundle prediction from raw X matches the Python reference path
RunResult.export() and export_model() refuse unsupported dag-ml exports unless compatibility="legacy-refit" is explicitly named
blockers.missing_contract: None for the V1 no-implicit-refit contract. Unsupported dag-ml export shapes now raise a structured refusal by default; the legacy-refit bridge is only a named compatibility opt-in.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep the native bundle and post-W2J source gates green; broaden replay only after richer stacking layout contracts exist.

blockers.title: dag-ml stacking OOF/refit semantics match legacy sklearn behavior
expected_evidence: dag-ml exposes an explicit contract for incomplete OOF coverage
refit-skip or validation-coverage behavior is no longer implicit
dag-ml and dag-ml-data lockstep validation still passes
blockers.missing_contract: None for the dag-ml runtime contract. W51 added explicit require_full_coverage, cv_only, and skip_refit_on_incomplete_oof semantics with stable diagnostics.
blockers.next_owner_action: Consume the contract from nirs4all fallback-drain work; keep lockstep validation green.

blockers.title: By-source feature layout is stable across dag-ml-data and nirs4all
expected_evidence: source/block order is serialized in a shared contract artifact
nirs4all by-source parity probes no longer infer feature layout heuristically
lockstep validation passes against the dag-ml integration tip
blockers.missing_contract: None for the shared dag-ml-data/dag-ml contract. W53 added source_layout and W61 synchronized the dag-ml mirror.
blockers.next_owner_action: Consume source_layout in nirs4all by-source lowering; W54 keeps strict xfail probes until that consumption is implemented.

blockers.title: Studio compute routes preserve runtime provenance and fallback diagnostics
expected_evidence: route retries preserve requested engine, actual engine, fallback status, and RtError metadata
remaining compute paths are runtime-backed or listed as explicit blockers
bypass parity tests fail if legacy is called silently
blockers.missing_contract: No remaining W55 route-bypass blocker. Strict release validation must still run the Studio gate in the prepared cutover workspace.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep W55 route-level parity in the cutover gate and add new bypass cases only when new routes are introduced.

blockers.title: Web runtime exposes no-fallback behavior and smoke coverage
expected_evidence: allowFallback=false is observable in browser/runtime errors
single-file build carries runtime metadata
served smoke covers fallback diagnostics
blockers.missing_contract: No remaining W56 adoption blocker. Served worker smoke now checks Python-compatible RtResult/RtError wire shapes.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep typecheck, runtime tests, build, single-file build, and served smoke in strict cutover validation.

blockers.title: Standalone toolbox can lower or preserve legacy outputs safely
expected_evidence: legacy artifacts are never migrated in place
strict conversions refuse unsafe data before output
native result sidecars are either semantically lowered or preserved with checksums
blockers.missing_contract: No remaining blocker for the W59 metadata preview/refusal contract. Native prediction arrays remain preserved in the source predictions.parquet until a future sidecar lowering slice.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep strict native-results preflight and CLI migrate/verify smoke green; extend to array sidecars only after the workspace grouping contract is fixed.

blockers.title: Aggregation release lock matches member contract artifacts
expected_evidence: aggregation-manifest.n4a.json validates
aggregation-lock.n4a.lock.json agrees with current member artifacts
audit-fetchability --fail-on-unfetchable passes from clean clones
every locked commit is advertised by its configured repo_url
blockers.missing_contract: None for the selected RC-v1 lock. On 2026-07-02, release_lock_validation and release_lock_fetchability_audit passed, with 7/7 locked member commits advertised by their configured repo_url.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep release_lock_validation and release_lock_fetchability_audit green whenever the manifest, lock, or selected member heads change.

blockers.title: Lite aggregate exposes the required Python/R/WASM V1 surfaces
expected_evidence: make test-v1-surfaces runs the Python aggregate surface
make test-v1-surfaces runs the WASM/browser aggregate surface
the R aggregate surface is governed only by the existing test-r-if-available policy
blockers.missing_contract: None for the current lite V1 surface accounting. A local missing-R skip remains a release risk to report, not a substitute for an R proof on release infrastructure.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep lite_v1_surfaces green with the selected Node path and PYTHONPATH; do not add ad hoc R skips outside test-r-if-available.

blockers.title: Post-W2J default engine and strict fallback/export state is verified
expected_evidence: RC-v1-nirs4all-python declares DEFAULT_ENGINE = "dag-ml"
nirs4all.api.run.run defaults allow_fallback to false
fallback compatibility remains explicit through engine="legacy" or allow_fallback=True
dag-ml export compatibility remains explicit through compatibility="legacy-refit"
blockers.missing_contract: None for the post-W2J default-engine state. This row no longer represents a pre-flip expected failure.
blockers.next_owner_action: Do not reintroduce a legacy default or implicit legacy fallback/export bridge; run the strict full gate set in a prepared release workspace before claiming V1 release readiness.

blockers.title: Python and Studio legacy-vs-dag-ml performance comparison is gated
expected_evidence: n4a-benchmarks perf-compare runs python_run and studio_run for legacy and dag-ml
allow_fallback is false and recorded engine must match requested engine
dag-ml/legacy run ratios stay below python_run=1.25 and studio_run=1.35
JSON and Markdown reports are emitted for cutover evidence
blockers.missing_contract: No missing command contract. Thresholds are conservative RC ceilings and must be recalibrated if the CI host class or measured workload changes.
blockers.next_owner_action: Run perf_cross_engine_compare in the final cutover sweep before production flip; keep Benchmarks tests strict so the command cannot silently drop fallback or ratio assertions.

blockers.title: Providers local sibling release gate passes without write coupling
expected_evidence: repository and benchmarks adapters can read/list/get pipelines without write coupling
the local release gate verifies sibling source layouts before adding them to sys.path
datasets and repository transitive dependencies come from explicit local venv dependency paths
blockers.missing_contract: None for the W2S local sibling provider release proof. Bare missing-dependency failures remain strict and must not be papered over with fake imports.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep providers_local_sibling_release in the non-full release gate run; upload/write APIs remain intentionally out of scope.

blockers.title: Cluster scheduler contract covers DAG rights and result provenance
expected_evidence: server can schedule DAG-shaped jobs to registered clients with rights metadata
client-submitted jobs preserve runtime/result provenance
distributed parity tests cover the scheduler contract
blockers.missing_contract: No blocker for the W58 whole-run DAG rights/result provenance contract. Fine-grained DAG node/fold scheduling remains deferred.
blockers.next_owner_action: Keep cluster advisory for DEFAULT_ENGINE cutover; promote to a strict release gate when cluster is included in the V1 artifact set.
